about: Commitment to the Q-129 hold-out test set v4 (n8n data sync with checks, Upwork item 4), written for the second gated series after the first hold-out was spent (P5 FAIL on H-R02, 2026-10-26). The cases were written by a separate session that never builds the workflow and never opened tests/cases/, tests/make_cases.py source, tests/make_sweep.py, workflows/, tests/results/, evals/RESULTS.md, the shared notes or any older hold-out, from tests/CASES.md, evals/eval_config.yaml and BLUEPRINT.md section 5 at gate commit 39b5c7d (gate v4) only, and sealed before the second gated series. This file holds only counts and hashes, no case content.
written_by: separate Claude Code session (Opus 5.5), hold-out writer only; owner Kristian Kobescak
count_per_result_rule: one count per webhook or replay step, by the first listed expected result (2 parallel steps also accept updated and skipped_duplicate); summary steps counted apart
checks_before_sealing: python tests/make_cases.py --check holdout.json --set holdout exit 0 at 39b5c7d, also on the file extracted from the archive into a new empty folder; write_holdout.py regenerates holdout.json byte for byte
checker_printed_sha256_note: the SHA-256 the checker prints on its OK line for this file at 39b5c7d; it is not the SHA-256 of the file bytes
kept_at: folder q129-holdout-v4 in the owner's user profile, outside every repository
how_to_open: At the gated runs only: check that the SHA-256 of holdout.zip equals archive_sha256; if it does not, the hold-out result is void. Extract into a new, empty folder, check that holdout.json has holdout_json_sha256, stop on any case ID or order number shared with tests/cases/visible.json, run python tests/make_cases.py --check <extracted holdout.json> --set holdout (any refused case is an owner decision, recorded in evals/RESULTS.md), then follow README.txt inside.
